story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 전통 문화가 살아 숨쉬는 '인사동' 상공입니다. 잠시 착륙해서 차 한 잔 어떠세요?
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en jeon-tong mun-hwa-ga sal-a sum-swi-neun in-sa-dong sang-gong-im-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, we're now above 'Insadong', where traditional culture is alive and well. How about landing for a cup of tea?

story.text: 이 골목의 '찻집'들은 대부분 100년 넘은 한옥을 개조한 곳이에요. 분위기가 정말 특별하죠.
story.reading: i gol-mog-ui chat-jib-deul-eun dae-bu-bun baeng-nyeon neom-eun han-og-eul gae-jo-han gos-i-e-yo.
story.en: Most 'teahouses' in this alley are renovated hanok houses over 100 years old. The atmosphere is truly special.

story.text: '오미자차'부터 드셔볼까요? 다섯 가지 맛(달고 짜고 맵고 쓰고 신맛)이 한 번에 느껴져요.
story.en: Shall we start with 'omija tea'? You can taste five flavors — sweet, salty, spicy, bitter, sour — all at once.

story.text: 몸이 으슬으슬할 땐 '쌍화차'가 최고예요. 한약재를 오래 끓여 만들어서 정말 따뜻해져요.
story.en: When you feel a chill, 'ssanghwa tea' is best. It's simmered from herbal medicine ingredients and really warms you up.

story.text: 차를 정성껏 우리고 나누는 과정 전체를 '다도'라고 해요. 마음을 가다듬는 전통 예술이죠.
story.reading: cha-reul jeong-seong-kkeot u-ri-go na-nu-neun gwa-jeong jeon-che-reul da-do-ra-go hae-yo.
story.en: The whole process of carefully brewing and sharing tea is called 'dado', the tea ceremony — a traditional art of calming the mind.

story.text: 차 한 잔 하며 마음이 편안해지셨나요? 이제 오늘 배운 단어들로 문제를 풀어봐요!
story.reading: cha han jan ha-myeo ma-eum-i pyeon-an-hae-jyeo-sseo-na-yo?
story.en: Did you feel your mind relax over a cup of tea? Now let's solve some questions with today's words!

words.example: 좁은 골목 사이로 오래된 찻집들이 보입니다.
words.example_reading: job-eun gol-mok sa-i-ro o-rae-doen chat-jib-deul-i bo-im-ni-da
words.example_en: Old teahouses can be seen along the narrow alleys.
Omija tea has five distinct flavors.
Ssanghwa tea warms up your body.
Dado is a tradition that calms the mind.

sentences.en: Insadong is a street where tradition and art coexist.
The teahouse atmosphere is cozy and quiet.
Omija tea is characterized by a tangy-sweet taste.
One cup of ssanghwa tea can chase away a cold.
Learning the tea ceremony makes your mind calmer.
